known_outcomes_and_selection: The complete frozen LAT pool has 20 all-six passes and 20 physical rejections, including LAT-CANDIDATE-057. LAT057 was already supplied as a near-robot failure example. Select it explicitly after those outcomes, not as an outcome-blind sample. Preserve its original geometry, controller traces and rejection. The new translated scene has a separate engineering identity and never replaces/refills any frozen slot.
authorization: User-approved RoboLab/paper-informed design, followed by explicit request for a separately disclosed native engineering attempt, measured scene and both goal paths. Full benchmark qualification first; no exploratory policy inference.
reference_capture: One zero-action native capture of the preserved LAT057 geometry, with measured articulation root, camera extrinsics, object footprints and collision-geometry inventory. This is not a rerun of its scored failed trials.
translation: Minimum-length horizontal translation of all non-table objects together, preserving height, orientations and relative task/goal geometry. Target initial cube GEOMETRIC CENTER at 0.50m Euclidean translational separation from the newly measured articulation root. Convert each center with its measured root-local offset. Robot, cameras and table remain unauthored and fixed.
target_interpretation: Engineering starting prior, not a paper-certified optimum, actor-root radius, authoring X coordinate or new scoring threshold. The cited experiments use different policies/domains and do not certify SGW grounding.
native_realization: Fresh translated-scene capture must bind exact USD and dependencies, report achieved cube-center/root distance, and compare actual robot/camera configuration. Apply existing 3mm/2degree pose consistency limits; record all differences rather than claiming bit-identical physics.
qualification: Run positive then negative goal, three fresh resets each, with the same measured virtual-TCP calibration and 450 actions/451 states per trial. Retain every raw state, issued action, RGB frame, reset warmup and complete viewport video, including failures and infrastructure partials. Independently replay original evidence before reporting six-trial outcomes.
clearance_boundary: Measure actual object footprints and both goal/transport corridors. Record available native arm/gripper collision-bound projections and contact evidence. Conservative AABB overlap is not proof of collision; unavailable or ambiguous measurements are never zero/safe. No new campaign is released by this demonstration.
resource_boundary: One successor GPU only. Required affinity to the four existing bt worker nodes plus required anti-affinity to active bt pods; preemption Never, no retries. Wait for natural capacity release. Do not pause, replace, edit or interrupt bt/bu, use a fifth GPU, provision resources or alter other workloads.
